name: tcop-docs-search
description: Tencent Cloud observability knowledge search skill. Use it when looking up product docs by alarm content, resolving an alarm strategy type, mapping a cloud product name to its ID, or finding API / alarm metric metadata and their recommended thresholds. 触发词：知识库、文档检索、产品文档、告警文档、告警策略类型、策略类型、云产品 ID、产品标识、 API 指标、指标元数据、告警指标、指标含义、推荐阈值、指标单位、命名空间。 何时不触发：实时指标查询、告警历史检索、日志检索、资源盘点等需要真实数据的场景不走本 Skill。
